messages:
leah: RFC draft up for review — quantized-routing + KV-eviction interplay. TL;DR: when we route to lower-precision kernels and eviction pressure increases, a subset of requests see 2-5x p99 latency spikes. Need to align on acceptance criteria and a safe canary roll. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/rfcs/quant-routing-eviction (draft)
raj: looked through the numbers. repro on two workloads: long-chat (avg seq 1200) and multi-turn search. Root cause seems to be KV miss amplification when quant kernels reduce cacheability for some key sizes. p95 stable, p99 regresses. I ran a quick microbenchmark: 
```
kernel=quant8
batch=1..8
kv_size=64..1024
// p99 jumps when kv_size ~ 256 and batch small
```
We should define p99 budget and a rollback threshold.
mike: +1 on metrics. Also want guardrails on model quality: quant routing must not increase generation error rates for our eval suite >0.5% (BLEU/ROUGE/our custom classifiers). We need a before/after eval set and automatic regression alert.
emma: SRE notes: what telemetry do we need? recommend: p50/p95/p99 latency per kernel variant, cache hit rate, KV eviction rate, GC/oom counts, GPU mem pressure, and end-to-end error budget. Add synthetic canary traffic that mimics long-chat and multi-turn search. Alerts: p99 > baseline * 1.5 for 5m -> auto rollback.
sarah: infra: packing and memory layout will change with quant kernels. Quantization can lower memory but change alignment -> fragmentation. We need a sched-safe flag in canary config so we don't overpack until canary passes. Also coordinate with Dedicated customers — some have locked kernels.
leah: suggested acceptance criteria (proposal):
- perf: p99 end-to-end for canary <= baseline_p99 * 1.15
- cost: unit token cost delta <= 10% improvement (no negative >10% worse)
- correctness: eval-suite regression <= 0.5% absolute on key metrics
- stability: no OOMs or error spikes during 1h canary window
- observability: dashboards + alert rules live in console before rollout
Canary plan: 1) internal 1% traffic 2) customer-beta 10% (opt-in) 3) gradual ramp 10->100 over 48h with automated gates. Thoughts?
raj: agree with gates. Additions: include KV cache-loss metric (delta hit rate) threshold: hit_rate_drop <= 5%. If hit rate drops more, throttle routing to quant kernels for long sequences. Also: fallback path must be <100ms extra tail added when triggered.
mike: add quality smoke tests to the canary pipeline: sample N requests from production traffic, replay to both kernels, diff outputs with our classifier. If classifier flags >0.5% divergence, block ramp.
emma: we should codify the rollback trigger list: p99 >1.15x for 10m OR hit_rate_drop>10% OR any GPU OOM. Also add an automated postmortem step if rollback occurs.
runtime-bot: nightly-ci: quant-routing unit tests: 142 passed, 3 flaky. perf-regression-suite: baseline vs quant-branch: p99 delta = +9% on long-chat, +2% on short-chat. Link: https://ci.redwood/quant-routing/17685
leah: customer ask: AtlasPay asked for 2x cost reduction on embeddings generation and lower latency for short queries. We should map AtlasPay's SLAs to canary — offer opt-in and a controlled rollout. Raj, can you prepare a short impact matrix for AtlasPay?

raj: on it. preliminary: AtlasPay uses short seqs mostly; quant routing gives 15-20% cost improvement there with negligible quality loss. The long-chat regression is not in their workload but still blocks global rollout.
mike: propose acceptance test payloads: 
- eval-set-A (short seqs, finance prompts)
- eval-set-B (long conversation threads)
We keep separate thresholds per workload class.
leah: action items: 
- raj: impact matrix + canary config snippet (due EOD)
- mike: eval-suite baseline + diff pipeline (2 days)
- emma: alert runbook + synthetic canary config (1 day)
- sarah: sched-safe flag & dedicated customer opt-in policy (2 days)
- leah: write launch gating checklist and update PR

leah: thanks everyone :+1: I'll update the RFC with these acceptance criteria and the canary snippet. Ping me if you want to add specific thresholds.
raj: quick canary config draft below for comments:
```
canary {
  traffic_pct: 1
  duration: 60m
  metrics: [p99, kv_hit_rate, gpu_oom]
  thresholds: {
    p99: 1.15
    kv_hit_rate_drop: 0.05
    gpu_oom: 0
  }
  sched_safe: true
}
```
mike: :eyes: good start. add quality_check: { classifier_threshold: 0.005 }

emma: I'll wire alerts to rollout automation. add me as oncall alias for the canary window.

leah: closing loop — I'll post updated RFC by tomorrow morning and tag this thread. Thanks! :rocket:
